programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES (2025)
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. programme.desc: Meredith McCord arrives in late spring and joins Capt. Justin Leake on the hunt for a fish she’s never caught before. Lo and behold, it’s a day fit for a king.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoor

programme.title: Flats Class

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Sail Kings

programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss is in Cape Coral, Florida with perfect conditions to chase a variety of inshore species!
After filming his son kill his first 200″ monster, Kris Seymour chases big bucks in Kansas, Oklahoma and Canada.

This week we celebrate the 40th Anniversary of Lone Wolf stands and the man that started it all, the Lone Wolf himself Andrae D’Acquisto. As we take a look back at Andrae’s career, how it all started and where its heading after 4 decades, Andrae shares some insights on his hunting strategies and the equipment he has designed that made him one of the top bowhunters in the country!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: With the local Key West ship wrecks covered in Permit, Rush takes good friend and marine artist KC Scott fishing for "inspiration." While permit is the plan, the boys stay rigged and ready for the numerous species the Florida Keys may deliver when fishing offshore.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The most important fish catch is the one that got you hooked on fishing in the first place, and for many of us that catch happened early in life. On this episode Ali and Rush grab their favorite little fishing buddies for a great day on the water on their respective coasts. In Florida, Rush spends time with his son Kade fishing for huge permit while Ali takes his nephew Duke out for some wholesome yellowtail action in California.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As the SoCal Bluefin Tuna fishing season begins to take shape, Ali and Rush head out to fish the waters of San Diego and see what new surprises may be in store for them this year. For many boats in the fleet, the heading turns to the south for a visit to the commercial tuna pen operation that often attracts other fish from miles away. It's parking lot fishing at its best, but with a change in technique and break from the crowd Ali puts Rush on the bite!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: When it comes to fishing and the marine industry, we are often more united by the Bluefin tuna than we think. For Ali Hussainy, the Bluefin is responsible for fueling his life long passion as an angler, and in this episode he gets to share that passion with two friends that have their own ties to the species. For wildlife biologist Forrest Galante and master sushi chef Hiroyuki Terada, catching a bluefin tuna on rod and reel will be a first!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.desc: On opening day of Missouri’s gun season, hunters from around the state seek ridges and box blinds throughout the “Show Me” state in search of mature whitetail bucks. programme.title: Winchester Life

Join Team Winchester as they stalk, call, flank and roost boss gobblers into range from coast to coast.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Local Lines
programme.desc: Lights, camera, generator, crossbow... Action! This is one wild ride that anyone can have fun on. Come along on this night time bow hunting adventure in Crystal River Fl.

programme.title: Local Lines

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux

programme.title: Nazareth - Homecoming: The Greatest Hits Live from Glasgow
programme.sub-title: Nazareth - Homecoming: The Greatest Hits Live from Glasgow

programme.title: Hans Zimmer - Live in Prague
programme.desc: This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr.

programme.title: Neil Young - Three More Decades

programme.title: Kiss - Live in Nürburgring

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.sub-title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Carrie Underwood -- Live in London 2015

programme.title: Leon Bridges -- Live in London 2015

programme.title: Tom Odell - Live at Irving Plaza
programme.sub-title: Tom Odell - Live at Irving Plaza

programme.title: Ziggy Marley - Live at the Filmore
programme.sub-title: Ziggy Marley - Live at the Filmore
programme.desc: The Fillmore Auditorium is a historic concert hall in San Francisco, California. Founded by Bill Graham, it was named after being located originally on the corners of Fillmore Street and Geary Boulevard.

programme.title: R.E.M. -- Live in Milan 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Arena Civica, Milan, this concert film will give all fans a live experience from start to finish; R.E.M. performs unforgettable versions of their hits — "Losing My Religion", "Drive," "Man On the Moon" and many more.

programme.title: Coldplay - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Carlos Santana - Greatest Hits: Live at Montreux 2011
programme.sub-title: Carlos Santana - Greatest Hits: Live at Montreux 2011
programme.desc: Masterfully filmed in Montreux in July of 2011, this epic show captures the band performing their classics hits such as Jingo, Evil Ways and Black Magic Woman their later No.1 hits Maria, Maria and Smooth. programme.title: Journey - Live in Manila

She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL)
programme.sub-title: WPBL 2026 - Pune vs Mumbai - Day 10 Tie 2
programme.desc: Experience the electric intensity of the "Maharashtra derby" as local rivals Pune United and Mumbai Pickle Power clash at the Jio World Garden in a match hailed as one of the season's best. Mumbai ignites the home crowd with a dominant early lead, fueled by Jada Bui’s emotional victory over a "fearful" Katie Morris and a clinical masterclass from Brandon and Glauca Carvajal Lane in mixed doubles. However, the tide turns in a dramatic "tale of two halves" as Pune United mounts a stunning comeback. Witness the high-power precision of Bolin Bako as he derails Max Green’s momentum, sparking a relentless surge that sees Pune sweep the final three matches to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat. This tie is a masterclass in team resilience and tactical pressure under the lights in Mumbai.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos pide una orden de alejamiento contra su esposa, quien mantiene una papa en la vagina. Juan solicita la custodia de su hijo porque su pareja es satanista y teme por su salud física y mental.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Madre e hija disputan hijo; Misma casa 4 inquilinos desalojados
programme.desc: Karla quedó embarazada de su padrastro, al parir le dejó el bebé a su madre y ahora ella no se lo quiere devolver. Pilar le exige a Tania desalojar la casa que le alquiló antes de que la destruya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niña insatisfecha con su vagina; Anchón ayudando a otros niños
programme.desc: Una niña de 14 años tiene la vagina deformada; insatisfecha, quiere autorización para operársela y lucir mejor. Una madre no deja que su hijo autista ayude a niños con cáncer; Ignacio la amenaza.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Perdí papeles por sexo; Atleta golpea esposa
programme.desc: Johnny fue despedido por no complacer el acoso sexual de su jefa; ahora exige una compensación. Ignacio golpeó a su esposa, lo grabaron y publicaron el video; él demanda a quien lo hizo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La hija de la mula; Testamento infame
programme.desc: Helen se niega a darle la residencia en EE. UU. a su hija; el papá de la niña, Felipe, la demanda para obligarla. América pide emanciparse porque descubrió que su madrastra es la amante de su hermano.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Donación post mortem para arte; La lucha por Sabrina
programme.desc: Una artista dona su cadáver para exponerlo en una galería de arte, pero su marido Luciano intenta impedirlo. Luis quiere quitarle la custodia de su hermana con síndrome de Down a su enfermera Libia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marian exige que Gary interne a su hermana, pero él alega que Emily solo necesita unión familiar. A Karla le traumatizaba el tráfico, quiso cambiar de horario y fue despedida; ahora exige una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Dúo de magia; Hija con cáncer y embarazada
programme.desc: Un mago quiere desalojar a su aprendiz por revelar muchos trucos. Una adolescente está embarazada, pero tiene cáncer. Sus padres debaten si salvar la vida del futuro bebé o la de su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina enviudó y se casó con Franco. Pero el esposo de Paulina reapareció y ahora Franco los demanda. Federico es minusválido y sufre de erecciones. Elizabeth se aprovechó y se embarazó, pero ahora Federico reclama al bebé.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo de mi hermano no; Luchadora para salvar hijo
programme.desc: Raquel necesita ser parte de la vida de su hijo con Roberto, pero este dice que no porque el niño es producto de un incesto. Tania es una ex luchadora que quiere volver al ring, pero su hijo se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Papaya y pepino; Golpe por golpe
programme.desc: Un hombre le da educación sexual a dos niñas con vegetales; una madre lo denuncia. La esposa de una de las víctimas de un juego mortal demanda al agresor de su marido por 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amenazas por Facebook; Esposa millonaria vieja
programme.desc: David subió un video en Facebook donde dice que va a matar a su amiga; piden una orden de alejamiento. Camilo quiere sacar a su mujer de la casa y quedarse con la sirvienta que se ganó la lotería.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Depredador injusto; Padre stripper, scary boyfriend
programme.desc: María le exige a su marido que desaloje a su hermano por ser un depredador sexual, ella teme por su niña. Un padre acusa a la madre de su hijo de ser drogadicta y pide la patria potestad.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Cocaína para pre eyaculación; Legalización venta de órganos
programme.desc: Camilo usa cocaína como remedio para su eyaculación precoz; la esposa denuncia que la drogó. Un padre quiere comprar un riñón en Irán para su hija, pero la madre demanda que se lo prohíban.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Hijo preso por defender a novia; Lesbianas odian a los hombres
programme.desc: El hijo de Melba está preso en Colombia por defender a su novia; la mamá pide que ella lo ayude. Mario quiere quitarle su hija a Elly, alega que ella la contamina con odio hacia los hombres.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Youtube reina del toilet; Se inyecta pene
programme.desc: Un hombre planea convertir a su esposa en "la reina del toilet". Elizabeth, su suegra, pide una orden de alejamiento. Iván se inyecta un medicamento en el pene para más potencia; su esposa quiere el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La chismosa de la farándula; Esposo cojo, esposa asexual
programme.desc: La Pitonisa exige una orden de alejamiento por agresión contra la cantante Nati. Pedro quiere divorciarse de Ana, quien alega ser asexual. Pedro asegura que ella lo rechaza porque le falta una pierna.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El barbero del bichote; Riñón por virginidad
programme.desc: Nathaniel le exige a Medi que le devuelva la custodia de su sobrino. Carla le dona un riñón al hombre que ama a cambio de que le quite su virginidad. Ahora la esposa demanda a la donante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Con leucemia entrega hija; Casanova persa
programme.desc: John exige la custodia de la hija que su hermano, preso, tuvo con Franchesca, quien sufre leucemia. Daniela solicita extender la orden de alejamiento para Hamed porque la agredió varias veces.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Rumpólogo: Lectura de nalga; Sugar Daddy de universidad
programme.desc: Nataly va a que le predigan el futuro a través de sus nalgas; su esposo no lo tolera y solicita la custodia del niño que tienen en común. Jorge se llevó a Evelyn a su casa, pero ahora pide su desalojo; ella quiere una compensación.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Musulmán discriminado - ISIS; Ayuda para Ana
programme.desc: Eduardo, musulmán, fue despedido por defender a los terroristas de ISIS. Ahora solicita 100 mil dólares de indemnización. Carol teme que Ana se suicide y exige que la internen en un psiquiátrico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Exnovia mando 77 mil txt msgs; Mamá dona riñón con tumor
programme.desc: Leopoldo demanda una orden de alejamiento para Paula, su exnovia, porque lo acosa. Karla espera incapacitar a su mamá, quien es diabética y va a donarle un riñón a su novio menor que ella.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Abuela toma baños de luna; Grupo oro sólido
programme.desc: Yuri quiere que alejen a Ana de su abuela de 87 años porque la induce a fumar marihuana. La bailarina Lina intenta anular un contrato con Felipe, ya que él pretende que ella baile desnuda.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Esposo chavista; Ayuda para hermana de crianza
programme.desc: Edgar es antichavista y no acepta que su exmujer se lleve a su hija a Venezuela con su nuevo esposo chavista. Shariz le exige a Hilda que busque ayuda para su hermana de crianza, Nayla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El embarque de Luisa; Joven sin ganas de vivir
programme.desc: Lázaro le hizo una promesa a San Lázaro y ahora se viste como el santo, por eso Luisa se va a divorciar. Martín tiene una enfermedad terminal y piensa quitarse la vida; su madre pide que lo salven.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mónica exige anular un contrato que firmó con Ricardo, su ex yerno, y con su hija. Mónica se prestó para ser madre subrogada, pero ahora su hija y su yerno se separaron y Mónica quiere abortar a la criatura.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El órgano que nunca tuve; Gusano come carne
programme.desc: Juan nació sin miembro viril. Aunque pudo casarse, quiere injertarse un pene. Cristina exige una indemnización por la muerte de su esposo, quien murió a causa de un gusano que se come la piel.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Niño nena de mamá; Mamá, paga por tu abandono
programme.desc: Un niño que se siente mujer desde su nacimiento decidió tomar hormonas femeninas para iniciar su cambio de sexo. Magdalena fue abandonada por su mamá y demanda 18 mil dólares de manutención.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Alondra exige terapia psicológica para su esposo Luis, quien está obsesionado con una famosa llamada Vampy. María pide que su madre le permita hablar con su padre, a quien daba por muerto.

programme.title: Classic Canadian Sasquatch Stories
programme.desc: For as long as human beings have braved the mountain passes and rugged trails of the Canadian Rockies, stories have been told of a huge, elusive, man-like creature that haunts the slopes. Though scarcer and more obscure than its famous West Coast counterpart, this mysterious alpine monster has nonetheless found its way into foundational ethnological treatises on Canada’s First Nations, and into seminal works on the Sasquatch phenomenon. In this episode, we will delve into classic legends of and encounters with the wildman of the Canadian Rockies.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia le dice a la madre Pilar que quiere ver a Milagros al día siguiente en su oficina, ya que piensa que Milagros le dio a Enzo el golpe que se merecía; pero no sólo eso, sino que siente que le debe a Milagros que salvara a su hija Gina de un secuestro. Clemencia reunida con su familia les dice que tomó tres decisiones, quiere que Gina se vaya a estudiar a Boston, que Enzo formalice su relación con Vicky y que pongan fecha de matrimonio.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Milagros consigue trabajo en las empresas Talamonti, pero se da cuenta de que está enamorada de Enzo y sufre al saber que él tiene una novia con la cual se va a casar. Enzo le confiesa a Victoria que quiere terminar con el noviazgo porque está enamorado de Milagros. Y Augusto Talamonti anda en busca de Luis Francisco, va a buscarlo a su casa y su madre la señora Amada le dice que no está, pero le muestra documentos donde supuestamente se prueba que Luis Francisco es el medio hermano de Augusto.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Enzo le dice a Vicky que quiere terminar su relación porque está enamorado de Milagros. Amada lo cita Germán a su casa y le ordena que realice un atentado en contra de Clemencia Talamonti Clemencia citó a Luis Francisco en un lugar rodeado de vagabundos, que es el sitio en donde la dejaron abandonada a ella.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luís Francisco habla con Augusto, y le confiesa que todavía sigue enamorado de su esposa. Augusto, enfurecido al saber esto le dice que no lo quiere volver a ver. Luego, Luís Francisco habla con su madre, y ella le propone que tome lo que le pertenece de los Talamonti, y lo presiona por la deuda que tiene con un banco Italiano, pero él solamente quiere recuperar a Clemencia. De todos modos, Amada piensa encargarse de que los acreedores del banco Italiano le vayan a cobrar la deuda.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, gravemente enferma, pide ser enterrada con su vestido de novia y Ricardo promete casarse con ella al día siguiente. Mientras tanto, Manuela intenta mediar en el conflicto entre Ricardo, Misael y Glorita. René y Gustavo son arrestados tras un altercado, y Katiuska muestra su desprecio hacia la servidumbre. A pesar de su fiebre alta, Celia se niega a ir al médico y prefiere pasear con su familia para que todos los vean unidos antes de partir.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia, grave de salud, intenta aparentar normalidad antes de ser hospitalizada de urgencia. Misael y Glorita se realizan la prueba de ADN, mientras Misael confronta a Katiuska por sus mentiras. Ante su inminente final, Celia se confiesa y recibe los santos óleos. En un último gesto, la visten de novia para casarse con Ricardo en la clínica. Sin embargo, tras el "sí" de Ricardo, Celia muere antes de poder responder a la juez, dejando a María del Pilar sospechando un embarazo.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia muere repentinamente en plena boda con Ricardo, desatando el caos. Mientras María del Pilar revela su embarazo a un disgustado Marcelo, Katiuska genera conflictos familiares e insulta a Manuela, ganándose el reproche de Ricardo. Giovanni llega con el testamento y se realiza el velorio de Celia, marcado por visitas inoportunas. Ante la tragedia, un Ricardo devastado le suplica a Manuela que no lo abandone y lo apoye en este difícil momento.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo busca consejo en Manuela tras la muerte de Celia. Ella le sugiere mudarse con sus hijos, mientras Jade insulta a Benjamín tratándolo como Néstor Cordido. En el cementerio, Elizabeth y Moisés sufren por la pérdida. María del Pilar anuncia su embarazo a René y Gustavo, generando dudas sobre la paternidad de Marcelo. Finalmente, Hortensia y Benjamín planean viajar con Glorita, y Cecilia regresa al hato para organizar el futuro de sus sobrinos tras hallar sobres escritos por Celia.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín intenta huir del país con Hortensia y Glorita, pero es arrestado en el aeropuerto por las autoridades y Ricardo. Katiuska queda al frente del emporio Tarifa. Romina persuade a María del Pilar de fingir su embarazo para casarse con Marcelo. Amparo defiende la inocencia de Benjamín, mientras Ricardo recrimina a Manuela por no avisarle sobre Glorita. La tensión aumenta tras la captura de Benjamín, quien niega su verdadera identidad ante la policía.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos logra que Junior reaccione tras el desmayo. Adolfo y Consuelo revelan a Rosa que su matrimonio debe anularse porque Junior es su hermano; ella confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro. Blanca enfrenta a Arminda por haberle ocultado el paradero de Rosa toda la vida. Junior reclama a Marisela haberle ocultado la gravedad de su enfermedad. Erasto irrumpe en su casa al ver a Blanca y la amenaza, pero ella le anuncia que peleará por sus tierras. Rosa jura que siempre considerará a Carmen Rosa como su única madre y nunca dejará a Junior solo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos consuela a Junior por su enfermedad y propone medicina alternativa para curarlo, que sus padres aceptan. Marisela ofrece a Alejandro mudarse a casa con Rosalía durante los últimos momentos de Junior. Rosa, dudando de todo, visita a Erasto buscando la verdad sobre su secuestro. Eustoquio amenaza a Erasto con denunciarlo. Blanca le pide a Alejandro recuperar sus tierras y averiguar la muerte de Benedicto. Rosa cae en la trampa de Erasto, quien le da su versión manipulada culpando a Blanca, pero ella le aclara que nunca olvidará que mató a su hermano Carlos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos explica a Junior que la cura es imposible y debe aceptar su realidad. Rosalía traiciona a Alejandro informándole a Erasto sobre sus planes para recuperar las tierras de Blanca. Marisela exige a Rosa callar la verdad ante Junior. Rivero hace desaparecer documentos por orden de Erasto. Junior pide a Rosa el divorcio para liberarla, pero ella se niega. Alejandro descubre que Rosa espera un hijo suyo y le pregunta qué hará. Blanca y Consuelo acosan a Carmen Rosa con preguntas en el hospital; Rosa irrumpe y las expulsa furiosamente.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luís Francisco habla con Augusto, y le confiesa que todavía sigue enamorado de su esposa. Augusto, enfurecido al saber esto le dice que no lo quiere volver a ver. Luego, Luís Francisco habla con su madre, y ella le propone que tome lo que le pertenece de los Talamonti, y lo presiona por la deuda que tiene con un banco Italiano, pero él solamente quiere recuperar a Clemencia. De todos modos, Amada piensa encargarse de que los acreedores del banco Italiano le vayan a cobrar la deuda.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: La muerte imprevista de Diego sembró un dolor durísimo en Daniela, pero también dejó a la luz que las sospechas de su deceso recayeran sobre Pedro, quien continúa moviendo las fichas en las vidas de todos los vecinos del condominio. Tanto es así, que luego de que la autopsia determinara “muerte natural”, intenta convencer a Daniela para que no venda el apartamento. Ella no podrá afrontar el costo mensual por el crédito bancario que con su marido habían sacado para comprarlo, y Pedro le ofrece un préstamo. Con esto, y ante la inminente seguridad de que tampoco podrá pagárselo, querrá quedarse con el apartamento.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Todo el mundo comienza a preguntar y Freddy es el que le dice a todos que esa pareja está empatada. Briggite está que se muere y comienza a preguntar que como es eso de que Yubileisy está empatada con su Whisky. Bienvenida sigue diciéndoles cosas a Yubiri y a Wilker. Ellos están pensando en ellos y Briggite totalmente fuera de lugar. Freddy y Solymar están afuera de la casa de Bienvenida hablando de lo mismo. Freddy le dice que es su héroe. Todos se van y se queda Yubiri con Briggite.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta se entera que no es hija de Ana Belén, por unos registros del hospital donde nació. Efraín y Ana Belén tratan de calmarla, pero no lo logran. Julieta se decide a irse de la casa, y Seis nueve le ofrece quedarse con Dilenis. Al día siguiente, Julieta se encuentra con Patricia, una monja que había ido a hacer un informe a ese barrio, y dos muchachos aparecen para acosarlas. Efraín habla con Valentina, para contarle lo sucedido, y ella le asegura que no fue quien le confesó eso a Julieta, cuando justo llega Ana Belén para hablar con Valentina. Nayarí decide contarle a Deibis que su tío es Gabriel León, pero a Deibis sólo le cae mal la noticia, ya que se había cruzado una vez con él, y no lo trató bien.

programme.desc: Eustoquio roba documentos clave del despacho de Rivero para vengarse de Erasto. Alejandro nota a Leticia extraña y vuelve con la policía. programme.title: Wild Travels

programme.title: Wild Travels

programme.title: Wild Travels

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore journeys deep into the heart of Upper Egypt—a land of ancient temples, royal tombs, and stories that have shaped civilizations. Sailing the Nile on a luxury cruise, Sandra explores legendary sites like Karnak, Abu Simbel, the Valley of the Kings, and the colorful Nubian villages near Aswan. Along the way, she shares powerful stories of queens like Hatshepsut, marvels at vibrant hieroglyphics in Seti I’s tomb, and sails silently on a traditional felucca. From spice markets to sacred temples, viewers experience the magic of Egypt through immersive storytelling and practical travel tips. Sandra offers advice on what to wear, how to stay safe, and why Egypt is a destination best explored with a professional planner. This episode is a feast of history, culture, and connection—inviting travelers to see if Egypt deserves a top spot on their travel bucket list.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: Samantha kicks off her visit to the Garden State in Cape May, and discovers how it played a pivotal role in the fight to end slavery. Other stops include Monmouth Battlefield State Park, Source Farmhouse Brewery and legendary music venue, The Stone Pony.

programme.title: Places To Love
programme.desc: The Mission Reach project in San Antonio provides walking trails and bike paths and will use portals to connect the San Antonio River to the four historic missions along the river. Samantha tours several of its stops including a visit to Mission Concepcion and learns the history of the river and the impact of this urban ecosystem restoration project.

programme.title: Places To Love

programme.title: Dr. Jekyll Likes Them Hot (2026)

programme.title: Blood Brothers (2024)
programme.desc: Nicola Bellizzi returns to Naples, after spending six years in a juvenile detention centre, determined to get out of his outcast status and become a lawyer. In the neighbourhood, Gaetano, known as Core e' Fierro, is the absolute boss of the guapperia. A clash takes place between the two young men; but the behaviour of Nicola, who defends Gaetano from the commissioner Ajossa who has caught them duelling, gives rise to a deep friendship between the two. After many denials, driven by necessity, Nicola agrees to become a guappo in turn during an initiation at the secret court to which he is introduced by Core e' Fierro. Lucia, Gaetano's woman, feels attracted to Nicola, but the two repress their desire. Ajossa wants to get his hands on Gaetano and sets a trap for Lucia, inducing her to yield to him in order to save her lover, so that the latter, in order to avenge the offence, will make a mistake.

programme.title: Black Bits (2025)

programme.title: Loaded Guns (2024)
programme.desc: Charming hostess Nora Green delivers a mysterious letter containing a death threat to boss Silvera. Hounded by thugs, but being able to rely on the help of a shrewd acrobat, Nora ends up finding herself at the center of a war between rival gangs that is taking place against the backdrop of Naples.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Rheta says her four-and-a-half-year marriage to Mark is headed down a rocky road, and her mother-in-law, Deb, is in the driver's seat. Rheta says it's time for Mark to cut the cord with the woman she calls deceitful, backstabbing, sneaky and controlling -- or else! Meanwhile, Deb says she hates Rheta, claiming she's violent, trashy and undeserving of her son. The tension between the women has escalated to blows on more than one occasion, leaving Mark literally in the middle. Where do his loyalties lie? Hear the drastic measures Deb has taken to get Rheta out of their lives. And, did Rheta reveal a secret in the hopes of ruining Deb's 31-year marriage? Is this a case of an overprotective mom overstepping her boundaries, or a wife's resentment getting the best of her? Dr. Phil mediates this war of words and helps to draw some lines in the sand. Whose side will Mark be on? Can this marriage and family be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil

Walt claims Rachel might have been involved in her sister’s death -- an accusation she strongly denies. Both agree to take a polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You hear about scams all the time - e-mails and voicemails claiming you have won valuable prizes. Dr. Phil is outraged by what some scammers are doing to him, his family and his viewers. One website offers a Dr. Phil quiz to win $5,000 every hour, another says it has the official Dr. Phil personality test, but even more shocking are 800 numbers that take callers' money for the promise of over the phone therapy with Dr. Phil and Robin. But these 800 numbers connect innocent victims with con artists posing as Dr. Phil staff members. The fake staffers ask anywhere from $375 to $1,000 for consultation time that obviously never takes place.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to children and sports, many believe there is a huge problem with entitled athletes. Are athletes being coached to believe they are individually more important than their teams and that the rules simply don’t apply to them? Dr. Phil sits down with parents, athletes, coaches, and students who all say yes – but they strongly disagree about who is to blame. A coach claims parents are to blame due to modeling outrageous and entitled behavior. However, the sports parents in Dr. Phil’s audience push back, claiming coaches need to stop blaming them and start blaming themselves. Then, meet a referee who wrote an emotional email to parents informing them he was quitting due to their sideline behavior. And, a former all-American quarterback talks about the dark side of college sports. Plus, ESPN investigative reporter Paula Lavigne reveals some of what she has uncovered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Football Star Accused: Did He Do It?
programme.desc: In a Dr. Phil exclusive, a 17-year-old football star accused of rape -- and the alleged victim -- speak out about how one alcohol-fueled night changed their lives in an instant. Matt says he and three friends were drinking at a party nearly nine months ago when the four boys had sex with a 16-year-old classmate. He claims she initiated the encounter and that the sex was consensual. Matt and the three boys are charged with second-degree rape, and Matt says his dreams of getting a college scholarship have been put on hold. How does he describe the events of that night? And, what, if anything, does he say he’d do differently? Then, hear from the alleged victim, who is speaking out for the first time. What does she recall happening that night? And, how has the ordeal impacted her life? Plus, Matt’s parents, Dianne and Mark, insist their son is innocent and say they believe the alleged victim is out for attention. Dr. Phil has a powerful message for the couple.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Hoarder update from social media star Glozell. Skin removal surgery shocker! Eyelid popping! Can fish oil improve your sperm count?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Horrible accidents and life-threatening conditions can happen to anyone at any time, even you! Learn how to prevent a critical head injury, E.coli poisoning, severe dehydration and more. And, spot the hazards in your home!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Top Reasons People Call In Sick
programme.desc: Sore throat, upset stomach, aches and pains -- find out when you’re most contagious and when it’s safe to go back to school or the office. And, how to determine if your child is too sick for school.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: THE DOCTORS uncovers potential health hazards that are lurking all around you. Many of your favorite restaurant meals have hidden sugars, fats and salts. THE DOCTORS and David Zinczenko, author of Cook This, Not That, show you how to prepare healthy versions of the same dishes at home. Do you know what’s in your body creams and lotions? Find out which skin care ingredients are toxic to your health. If you’re a regular customer at the car wash, you might want to put on the breaks. Find out what’s left behind after your car is professionally cleaned.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Can a vegetarian diet really increase the risk of a stroke? Are fake meat burgers the same as dog food? Should everyone be screened for Hepatitis C? Moms get help with sleepless toddlers! Are cold-pressed skin care and spray-on skin really a thing? Is your mouthwash raising your blood pressure? Plus, do emojis encourage more dates and sex?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Can a high-tech surveillance company keep your kids safe at school? Attorney and psychologist Lisa Strohman weighs in on the hot-button issue. OB/GYN facing charges of health care fraud after allegedly performing unnecessary surgeries on patients! Is the paleo diet safe while breastfeeding? A controversial new bill in Colorado is proposing young adults be tried as juveniles because the brain isn’t fully developed. Neuroscientist Dr. Don Vaughn and attorney and psychologist Dr. Lisa Strohman debate the pros and cons.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors tackle topics from the bedroom to the bathroom that make even the most stalwart blush. Hear S-E-X-planations for how to turn up the heat in the bedroom, and get solutions for ugly feet, spider veins and more!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors teach you how to improve your health sunup to sundown! Find out how to eliminate not-so-fresh morning breath, avoid frustrating razor bumps and make sleepless nights a thing of the past.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Are you your own worst critic? From sweaty armpits to thick ankles, see new solutions for your most “embarrassing” body problems. And, get simple, at-home remedies for brittle nails.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Plagued by rumors of crack use, meth use, cancer and his HIV status, pop star Aaron Carter comes to The Doctors in a world exclusive to find out what’s really going. Can Aaron on be saved from The wreckage of superstardom?

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ways To Take Charge Of Your Health
programme.desc: Is a simple seasoning the culprit for expanding waistlines? Most Americans consume two to three times the amount of salt necessary per day. The Nutrition Twins, registered dieticians, believe excess salt is largely to blame for America’s obesity epidemic. Learn their secret to staying skinny and try the diet designed to kick the salt habit for good! THE DOCTORS joins forces with Iams pet food to support Iams’ Home 4 the Holidays pet adoption program. Learn the health benefits of pets, for both humans and animals alike! A controversial court ruling in a worker’s compensation case may change the way employers hire. Will your weight jeopardize your job prospects? Plastic surgeon Dr. Drew Ordon demonstrates the latest wrinkle-relaxer on 35-year-old Jennifer. See the amazing after results! If you’re trying to lose weight, studies have shown that when you eat may be more important than what you eat. Snacking at the wrong time can increase your weight gain by 50 percent! Find out when to nibble and when to just say no. Pediatrician Dr. Jim Sears uncovers hidden choking dangers for toddlers and demonstrates what to do if your child’s airway is obstructed.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Drs: Why Does That Smell?
programme.desc: From foul gas to smelly ears, The Doctors answer your most pressing questions about the odors your body produces. And, editor-in-chief of Prevention, Liz Vaccariello, separates fact from fiction about a common medical myth.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The holidays are just around the corner! Get delicious recipes to cut fat and calories from traditional Thanksgiving fare. And, three tips to prevent overeating! Plus, burn off extra pounds fast with the No Excuses workout.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: One community is outraged after hundreds of high school students were body searched at school! A new California law that makes exposing others to HIV no longer a felony is causing controversy! Then, watching THE DOCTORS helped one woman detect her daughter’s cancer! How is she doing today? Next, a woman’s tattoo caused a shocking false diagnosis! And, survivors of the Las Vegas mass shooting share their harrowing story of survival! Also, the healthy tea you’re missing out on!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Comedienne Niecy Nash goes on assignment to uncover mystifying body quirks and what you can do about them. And, a new, minimally invasive procedure promises to put an end to heavy periods. Plus, common sex mistakes men make.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Are you constantly surfing the net trying to self-diagnose a mysterious pain? The Doctors reveal what symptoms are safe to ignore and when you need to pay closer attention. Learn the safe and scary causes of numbness, heart palpitations, easy bruising and more

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Treat It Now or Pay Later?
programme.desc: Actress Sally Field joins The Doctors to raise awareness about osteoporosis, a bone-thinning disease that affects four times more women than men. Learn steps to take to preserve the health of your bones.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Learn the truth about your best and worst health habits in an all-new hour with Dr. Travis! Concerned about the recent meningitis outbreak? Get must-know info to keep your family safe. Plus, new, FDA-approved weight loss pills. Could they work for you? The Doctors dress up as their favorite talk show hosts! And, Modern Family star Julie Bowen shares her spookiest health story. Could it happen to you? Plus, the candy that’s as harmful to your teeth as battery acid and more hair-raising health statistics.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors Exclusive: Gloria Gaynor’s major spine surgery. Gloria and her surgeon, Dr. Hooman Melamed explains the risky procedure. Tips to protect your family this flu season! Testing new non-surgical procedure to rid you of saggy skin and those dreaded jowls. The man behind some of Hollywood’s biggest superheroes shares his top workout moves anyone can do at home. The surprising germy spots in your kitchen!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Learn why your food spoils faster than it should, how long an unsightly pimple will last and the maximum hours of TV your child should be watching. Plus, the most effective one-hour workout!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Inside The ER with Dr. Travis Stork
programme.desc: Get an inside look at real-life trauma and drama as The Doctors follows Dr. Travis into the E.R. And, The Triplets, whose baby girls are all approaching their first birthday, are back! Get the answers to their biggest new-mom questions!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Improve your health from A to Z! From anti-aging to zits, The Doctors tackle common health concerns and share the latest medical treatments, simple cures and surprising tips to keep you in tip-top shape.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Give thanks to your well-being this year! THE DOCTORS helps you relish Thanksgiving without spoiling your health. Don’t let your feast deter your diet! Discover delicious calorie-cutting alternatives to your favorite Turkey Day dishes. Plus, learn why it’s OK to pile on the cranberry sauce! It’s a chicken stuffed into a duck stuffed into a turkey – have you ever tried a turducken? Get the nutritional facts and figures on the a-typical bird. Plus, Thanksgiving trends from around the globe. Could they spice up your celebration? Mind your manners! Learn proper etiquette at the table. And, eat too much too fast? Learn what to do if you overindulge.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors explores a community project aimed at healing the sick – with food! A new discovery could mean a cure for alcoholism? A young mom begins losing her vision after pregnancy? Beauty blogger recommends DIY lightening down there? A dad forced to change his daughter’s diaper on a dirty restaurant bathroom floor – and you won’t believe the photo!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Runny noses, stuffy heads and aching bodies can only mean one thing: cold and flu season is in full swing. Find out 40 ways to fight the flu and outsmart a cold! Plus, the latest technology to keep your gadgets germ-free.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Stool Squad is back to answer your most embarrassing poop-related questions! Disturbing Kim Kardashian look-a-like plastic surgery! Shocking celebrity beauty trend! Toddler hospitalized after using a toy makeup kit!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors teach you how to improve your health sunup to sundown! Find out how to eliminate not-so-fresh morning breath, avoid frustrating razor bumps and make sleepless nights a thing of the past.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors investigates lunchboxes! Could dangerous mold, fungus and bacteria be hiding in your child’s lunchbox? You may want to hit the brakes at the drive-thru … could cancer-causing chemicals be hiding in your fast food? An erotic website offers sex-ed for teens with a new “wellness” hub? A judge’s sentence is raising eyebrows: celibacy as punishment? Get your daily dose of gross with a viral earwax video! You might want to think twice before eating chicken with white stripes; find out why! And, how a penny could help you avoid sickness and save wads of cash in an emergency!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Caught on tape: a public meltdown at the gym! What to do when someone flies off the handle in public! Then, a 90-pound weight loss without surgery? Hear one woman’s personal tips that helped her get trim! And, The voice of beloved cartoon characters like Bugs Bunny, Ren and Stimpy, Doug and Futurama reveals his story of overcoming prostate cancer! The risk factors all men need to know! Plus, legendary Latin King of Comedy Paul Rodriguez opens up about his sister’s tragic diabetic death. Hear his heartache and his desire to improve his own personal health. Then, if you’re one of the 42 million Americans struggling with constipation, proctologist Dr. David Rosenfeld shares his top foods that can help you poop! Plus, a sweet trick for a bug-free BBQ!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Docs: Where, When and Why
programme.desc: From when your child should start talking to why hormones affect your mood, The Doctors tackles your biggest who, what, where, when and why questions. And, get the most effective home remedies from around the globe.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors highlights the other side of addiction: recovery. Witness the powerful life transformation of a man who lost his legs to heroin. Then, can a breakthrough brain treatment for pain and addiction offer hope to so many sufferers? Then, The Doctors investigates drug addicted healthcare workers who put the patients they are treating at risk. Hear a harrowing story of a mother who contracted a deadly disease at the hands of a drug-addicted hospital worker. Plus, find out how you can protect yourself from becoming a victim of a medical mistake at the hands of a drug-addicted provider. And, learn the key to harnessing hope when things feel hopeless.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Whether it’s puberty, menopause or old age, learn how to stay healthy at every age. Plus, get the ultimate guide to treating adolescent acne, and learn how to help your baby take his or first steps!

programme.title: Squadron 303: The Battle Of Britain (2018)
programme.desc: Based on Arkady Fiedler's bestseller, Squadron 303 relates the true story of the Polish pilots who were heroes in the Battle of Britain. Jan Zumbach is recovering from a plane crash in a sanatorium when WWII breaks out. The Nazi onslaught forces him to escape from occupied Poland. A similar fate awaits the heroic flight instructor, Witold Urbanowicz. Both make their way to Great Britain and carry on the fight against the Nazi Luftwaffe. Quickly, their heroism and skill catch the attention of commanders, and an elite, Polish fighter squadron is created: Squadron 303. At first they are underestimated and mocked, but thanks to the outstanding patriotism and bravery of its members, the squadron quickly wins respect.

programme.title: The Heart Of Me (2003)
programme.desc: In the 1930s Ricky Masters, an English businessman, marries Madeleine, a fine match socially, but the cultured aesthete is more and more attracted to her sister Dinah, a 'Bohemian' painter, and as they spend time together their affair becomes physical, even all the way; yet when she gets pregnant they decide to leave his marriage intact. He raises his son with Madeleine, who tells him only in 1946 that she knew after he had a car accident during a 'business trip' to southern France that caused Dinah to loose her unborn daughter; now Ricky wants to leave Madeleine, but she refuses a divorce; after a time in hospital he is told Dinah chose to move back to France without him while she's really living in London, still not the last twist of the drama...

programme.title: The Decline Of Western Civilization, Part II: The Metal Years (1988)
programme.desc: The second in Penelope Spheeris’ trilogy, The Metal Years takes a fast-paced look at the outrageous Heavy Metal scene of the late '80s. Set in Los Angeles, the film explores fascinating portraits of struggling musicians, fans and star-struck groupies. Featuring Alice Cooper, Ozzy Osbourne, Poison and members of Aerosmith, Kiss, and Motorhead as well as performances by Megadeath, Faster Pussycat, Lizzy Borden, London, Odin and Seduce, this raucous and entertaining chapter also chronicles the lonely naiveté of the striving bands, the endless flow of alcohol and drugs and the relentless sexism.

programme.title: Alligator (1980)
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones. The small reptile grows gigantic, escapes the city sewers, and goes on a rampage.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E01 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: It's So Peaceful In The Country
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Take Your Wife To A Convention
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Oliver Takes Over The Phone Company
programme.desc: Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Count Your Tomatoes Before They're Picked
programme.desc: For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Kind Word For The President
programme.desc: Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: How To Succeed In TV Without Really Trying
programme.desc: Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 1)
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born (Part 2)
programme.desc: It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Guess Who's Not Going To The Luau
programme.desc: Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.
